description.ja: • 2005年に登場した交直流近郊型電車で、常磐線、水戸線で活躍。
description.en: • An AC/DC suburban train introduced in 2005, active on the Joban Line and Mito Line.

description.ja: • E231系をベースに、競合する私鉄開業を念頭に高速化と安全対策が施された。
description.en: • Based on the E231 series, higher speeds and safety measures were implemented with the opening of competing private railways in mind.

description.ja: • 交直流電車の特徴である屋根上器具を再現。強化スカートが付属。
description.en: • Reproduces the characteristic rooftop fixtures of AC/DC trains. A reinforced skirt is included.
